basis: The authorized 20261015 native PAPER needed verified forced-tree shutdown. Python owned cleanup already drained cancellation, but the external normal-stop controller did not deliver native cooperative cancellation.
implementation: Native singleton acquisition publishes the actual runtime PID, supported protocol and a fresh32-hex start nonce. No binding becomes active on a failed singleton acquisition. Repeated acquisition retains the same generation.

Bounded4096-byte regular-file requests address only one root/PID/nonce/protocol. Wrong, partial, deeply nested, oversized, extra-field, stale and path-escaping frames are not accepted or deleted. Exclusive publication is idempotent only for an exact matching frame.

A watcher outside the entire _runner covers its startup and running loops. Its expected-stop exception reaches the caller only after the native supervisor drains the runtime. Repeated parent cancellation does not abandon an admitted filesystem thread or cleanup. A real runtime/cleanup failure is not hidden by the expected stop.

Only the native caller after asyncio.run finishes acknowledges owned cleanup. The controller requires both that matching completion receipt and observed process exit. Intent, a receipt alone, process disappearance or failed process observation cannot certify cleanup. Only matching artifacts are removed; older generations and operator artifacts remain.

Windows process observation holds a SYNCHRONIZE-only handle to the original process object, with pointer-sized ctypes signatures. WAIT_FAILED, denied opens and unknown results are not process exit. An actual exit with code259 is still recognized without confusing it with STILL_ACTIVE. Owner identity is reread after opening the process object.

Normal stop_stack requests cooperation before managed-tree or stack termination. It verifies the actual native owner against the repository command line. The helper has a15-second cooperative deadline and an independent20-second process deadline; a hung helper/venv tree is terminated only after original command-line/creation identity verification. Existing verified stack fallback and explicit Force-first emergency behavior remain.

No provider, config, SQLite, model or wallet import is needed by the stop requester. Final SQLite reconciliation still occurs only after the stack process census is empty. The separate existing finalizer contract is preserved.
